notes.title: Twitch integration
notes.notes: [p]The latest update of marble champions adds basic twitch integration to the game. When connected, viewers can join your session with the !join command in the twitch chat. After they have joined their marbles will appear in league and quick race modes.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also setup a marble show where your viewers marbles race against eachtother.[/p][p][/p][h2]How to set it up?[/h2][p]Step 1 - Open the twitch settings in the main menu, fill in your twitch username and channel and click connect.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/f54ca895982d8d66ee63497138c3df2722098e55.png"][/img][/p][p]Step 2 - The browser will open. Click authorize to connect the game to your twitch account and return to the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/408a3d22e0068d9984e5541bbe167544bb7f0697.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Step 3 - Choose Twitch from the racers option in the race setup menu's.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/2ad52a6bf7a824c24d3a5b9f3057ac7be2bdf6f5.png"][/img][/p][p]Step 4 - Viewers can now join your session with the !join command. They can also change their marble by using the !marble command.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/06cfdb499c72854bde3a9c3a2a2292be25a95c29.png"][/img][/p][p]Step 5 - Watch the marbles roll![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/bee5891adacd41910d5e3bf72b21706cc2fdd0cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you have any questions, find some bugs are have more feedback please join the discord server![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/069e6af832c2f1ce0daaf7f897a089485a19aca8.jpg"][/img][url="https://discord.gg/mp6G6hza"]Join the marble champions discord server![/url][/p]

notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
Based on feedback received after the demo, Marble Champions has undergone a major upgrade.

[previewyoutube=weSVE1NtsCM;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to improved gameplay, marble handling and level design, the game will now also include the following features
 
[b]Track Designer[/b]
Create and share your own racing tracks.

[b]Arena Battles[/b]
A competitive mode where players engage in various mini-games, knocking each other’s marbles out of the arena.

[b]Expanded Racing Events[/b]
New event types including Obstacle Run, Balance Run, Downhill Dash, Cannonball Run, Survival, and Drag Races, offering diverse challenges.

[b]Marble Show [/b]
Set up your own marble races, sit back, relax, and watch some marbles roll.

[b]Local Splitscreen Multiplayer[/b]
Friends and family can compete head-to-head in exciting local multiplayer races & battles.

[b]Time Trials[/b]
Race against the clock and try to set the fastest time on official and user created tracks.

Originally slated to be released in 2024, the release date has now been moved to early 2025, and playtests will start soon. If you would like to be part of this test, stay tuned for the next update or join the official Discord server for the latest news.

[url=https://discord.gg/Pw65BHwDFz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771123/069e6af832c2f1ce0daaf7f897a089485a19aca8.jpg[/img][/url]

- Increased the braking speed.
